lessons.name: mary_had_a_little_lamb
lessons.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
lessons.instructions: Right hand in C position. The tune uses fingers 1, 2, 3 and 5. The left hand plays one note per bar — listen for how C and G change the colour of the tune.
tips: Keep finger 4 resting on F even though it never plays.
Half notes get two counts: hold them.

lessons.name: mary_with_chords
lessons.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb (with chords)
lessons.instructions: The same tune, now with a left-hand chord in every bar. C chord: fingers 5-3-1 on C-E-G. G chord: fingers 5-2-1 on B-D-G — B and D are below the position, so the hand moves down one key.
tips: Play all three chord notes exactly together.
Practise the left hand alone until the chord change is smooth.
